_about: Persona filter fixture (src/agents/director/render.ts sanitizeForPlayerCharacter, m4-decisions D-112). Persona «Елисей», alias «землемер». Each text is one callback instruction. cut: the text claims the persona's inner state (thinks, feels, notices, remembers, wants, decides), so the entry is removed. kept: the persona is staged, acted upon, looked at, or someone else thinks about the persona, so the entry stays. The rule, by grammar: the persona as the SUBJECT of an inner-state verb (the name as written, i.e. the nominative, then up to three particles or auxiliaries such as «не», «вдруг», «начинает», then the verb); the persona as the DATIVE experiencer of «кажется», «хочется», «страшно» …; any case form of the name after an order word («пусть», «заставь», «дай» …) with an inner-state verb at most four words later; an inner-state noun right before any case form of the name («мысли Елисея»). Another case form before a verb is someone else's subject («Брат Елисея думает»: the brother thinks), so it is kept. A comma or any mark between the words breaks the chain.

cut.text: Елисей начинает понимать, куда ведёт тропа
Елисей не может решить, куда идти

cut.why: ё in the verb is folded

cut.text: Мира и Елисей думают о побеге
cut.why: the persona is one of the subjects

cut.text: Дай Елисею понять, что стражник лжёт

cut.why: a word between the order and the name, and one before the verb

cut.text: Елисею кажется, что за ним следят

cut.why: the alias after an order word
an English verb after a Russian name

kept.why: the genitive name is not the subject: the brother thinks
an NPC's thought about the persona
«лжёт» is an act, not an inner state
a comma breaks the chain: Мира thinks
seeing is not on the list, as in English
a nominative name with «кажется» is how he looks

kept.text: Письмо для Елисея лежит на столе
В прошлом Елисей служил в страже
kept.why: «прошлое» is not an inner-state noun here
a longer name is another person
the alias inside a longer word

kept.text: Елисей так и не может решить, куда идти
kept.why: «так и» are not fillers: the chain breaks (a known miss)
